pretreatments.description: Mechanical grinding of food waste using an in-sink food disposer with a strainer hole size of 0.75 cm.
Mechanical grinding of food waste using a manual meat grinder with a medium (1.0 cm) plate opening.
Mechanical grinding of food waste using a manual meat grinder with a small (0.5 cm) plate opening.
Addition of a commercial digestive enzyme formulation (Digest®, Enzymedica Inc.) in excess to the ground food waste.
Dilution of ground food waste with a buffered aqueous solution (0.5 M NaOH titrated into 0.5 M KH₂PO₄ to pH 6.5) to a COD concentration of 3.5 g COD L⁻¹.
Maintaining the assays in 1 L glass beakers maintained at 35 °C in a water bath.
Covering the beakers with plastic film (Glad® Cling Wrap) held with a rubber band to reduce evaporation and potential contamination.
